ambient_events: Water sheets down the curved wall in a constant, whispering film.
The echo of your own breathing comes back to you a beat late.
A drip finds the back of your neck with cold precision.
description: A long curved bend where the main tunnel doglegs and the walls run with seep. The brick underfoot is glazed slick with algae that has never seen a photon of sun. It connects the sump back west to the silt gallery south.
name: Dripping Bend
